changes: - Added Golduck
- Added Damp, Swift Swim
- Working on making this changelog look nicer.
- The main thing is that this changelog's data is now stored in a JSON file instead of regular old, plain text.
- But also, now there's some code to format the llines of code counter automatically! :)
- Improved the speed of showing summaries for pokemon with lots of moves.
- Switching between tabs of pokemon summaries no longer confuses it.
- You can now right click the inactive members of your party to view their summaries during battle.
- Anniversary! :)
- Oops, 4-1 was broken this whole time.
- Fixed a problem with effects that change the background during dialogue.
- Hides the ridiculously long decimals from volume sliders when floating point numbers go stupid.
- The ace pokemon system broke again fixed it yay
- Added Psyduck
- Added Zen Headbutt
- Added Cloud Nine
- Added an announcement that shows when you use a move while paralyzed.
- Many parts of the game that look for certain kinds of status effects should find them much faster now.
- Added the remaining pokedex entries.
- Added a toggle for showing/hiding the highlights around tiles.
- Added a toggle for showing/hiding the level of pokemon next to their names
- Fixed a softlock that would occur if your opponent ever used Bulldoze.

- Fixed yet another bug regarding moves that end the current turn. This time, pokemon would start attempting to use moves twice, then four times, then (etc) because when each move ended, it would start the next turn, but not stop their logic
- Fixed the way that you could still see tooltips on screen while people were talking
- Added a hard mode to 4-7
- Added lots of pokedex entries.
- You can now select text in a popup.
- Added some pokedex entries
- Added a new song for Gladion
- Finally made the wild pokemon battle music loop properly
- Added a background to 4-5 and another to 4-7
- Added an image for empowered psychic tiles.
- Backgrounds can now smoothly fade into each other without waiting for the previous one to disappear.
- Using a z-move now correctly removes energy from your meter
- I can now program special effects into moves for when they're used as a z-move
- I can now put fun rainbow text into move descriptions that only appears while using a z-move
- You unlock z-moves from beating level 2-7. Right now Normal ones are all that exist. Oh well.
- I can now have trainers within a level have pokemon with specific abilities.
- Custom abilities for all trainers from 1-1 to 1-7
- Added the Aroma Lady class
- Working on making levels able to have fun backgrounds.
- Added dialogue to 3-3
